title: 玻璃摩天大楼：壮丽的城市天际线有多“热”？
description: CHICO HARLAN, ZUNAIRA SAIEED2026年10月30日 Ulet Ifansasti for The New York Times One thousand feet above city traffic, from her new 74th-floor apartment, Anastasia Zeeman has the kind of enchanting views that only floor-to-ceiling glass can offer. She looks out on a skyline and horizon where storms and sunsets play out like big-screen movies. 城市车流上方约300米处，阿纳斯塔西娅·齐曼在她位于74层的新公寓里欣赏着只有落地玻璃才能提供的迷人景色。她眺望天际线和地平线，风暴与日落交织的景象宛如大银幕电影般上演。 But Malaysia’s tropical sun sometimes delivers what Ms. Zeeman calls a “wall of heat” radiating from her windows. 但马来西亚的热带阳光有时会带来齐曼所说的“热墙”，从她的窗户辐射进来。 More than any other form of architecture, glass skyscrapers testify to the human desire for sweeping views and a sense of rising above the fray. In some of the world’s fastest developing places — Dubai, Mumbai, Jakarta, Kuala Lumpur — they have become city-defining showpieces, signaling sophistication and rising financial clout. 与其他任何建筑形式相比，玻璃摩天大楼最能体现人类对开阔视野的向往，以及凌驾于尘嚣之上的追求。在迪拜、孟买、雅加达、吉隆坡等全球发展最迅速的城市中，它们已成为定义城市风貌的标志性建筑，象征着精致和日益增强的金融影响力。 And yet glass tends to be ill-suited for keeping out the heat, and its overuse often makes buildings more energy intensive to cool. That’s fueling a debate about whether these symbols of modernity make sense in a world growing hotter because of climate change. 然而，玻璃往往不适合阻隔热量，其过度使用常常使建筑冷却所需能耗更高。这引发了一场辩论：在因气候变化而日益炎热的世界里，这些现代性的象征是否还有意义。 Some argue that the ambition and innovation that spawned the high-rise era can help modern skyscrapers fend off rising temperatures while maintaining the million-dollar views. Others say the all-glass aesthetic is at odds with the environmental goal of reducing greenhouse-gas emissions. They say it is time to rethink city skylines. 一些人认为，凭借催生摩天大楼时代的雄心和创新，现代摩天大楼能够在保持价值百万美元的壮丽景观同时抵御气温上升。另一些人说，全玻璃美学与减少温室气体排放的环境目标相悖。他们说，是时候对城市天际线进行重新思考了。 When he was New York City mayor in 2019, Bill de Blasio briefly floated the idea of banning the “glass and steel” structures altogether. Philip Oldfield, an Australian architecture scholar who wrote a book on sustainable high rises, calls the glass towers “environmentally criminal.” Ken Shuttleworth, a prominent British architect who three decades ago helped design London’s Gherkin building, now says he’d do it differently, without quite as much glass all the way around. 2019年担任纽约市长时，比尔·德布拉西奥曾短暂提出全面禁止“玻璃和钢铁”结构的想法。写过一本关于可持续高层建筑书籍的澳大利亚建筑学者菲利普·奥德菲尔德称，玻璃摩天楼“在环境上是犯罪”。30年前曾参与设计伦敦“小黄瓜”大楼的英国著名建筑师肯·沙特尔斯沃思表示，现在他会采用不同方案，不会四周都使用那么多玻璃。 “You really just need to have smaller windows,” said Mr. Shuttleworth. He said his approach to skyscraper design has changed as he’s come to realize that “we are burning a hole in the planet.” “你其实只需要把窗户做小一些，”沙特尔斯沃思说。他说，随着他逐渐意识到“我们正在把地球烧出一个洞”，他对摩天大楼设计的思路已经改变。 穿透科威特的浓雾。伦敦著名“小黄瓜”大楼的建筑师之一表示，如果今天重新设计，他会减少玻璃的使用量。 Despite that criticism, the glass skyscraper’s appeal endures. 尽管有这些批评，玻璃摩天大楼的魅力依然不减。 The form, which originated in American cities like Chicago and New York, has now spread across China, the Middle East and Southeast Asia. Over the past decade, the world has constructed 25 times the number of buildings 200 meters (roughly 655 feet) or taller that it did in the 1980s, according to the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat. Some 91 percent of the world’s skyscrapers of that height have been built since the turn of the 21st century. 这种形式起源于芝加哥和纽约等美国城市，如今已传播到中国、中东和东南亚。根据高层建筑与城市人居委员会的数据，过去十年，全球建造的200米或更高建筑数量是1980年代的25倍。世界上约91%的这一高度摩天大楼是在进入21世纪以来建造的。 The “vast majority” have facades largely of glass, said Antony Wood, who was the president of that council until last year. 该委员会任期至去年的前主席安东尼·伍德说，“绝大多数”建筑的外立面主要是玻璃。 Proponents of glass-dominant design say this building spree can still be responsible if strategic choices are made. 支持玻璃为主设计方案的人士认为，只要做出战略选择，这种建筑热潮仍然可以做到环保。 Because the sun doesn’t hit a building equally from all directions, buildings can boost their energy efficiency simply with the right orientation. Architects can also add features like fins or undulations so less sunlight directly hits the glass. Stringing greenery on glass facades is also a trend. 因为太阳并非从所有方向均匀照射建筑，建筑只需通过合理的朝向设计，就能提高能源效率。建筑师还可以添加翅片或起伏等特征，减少阳光直射玻璃。在玻璃外立面上布置绿植也是一种趋势。 Glass can also be treated with gossamer-thin metallic coatings that reflect away radiation. Most buildings use several layers of glass to impede the heat. One high-end option involves sandwiching automated blinds between them. 玻璃还可以涂覆薄如蛛丝的金属涂层，以反射辐射热。大多数建筑使用多层玻璃来阻挡热量。一种高端选择是在玻璃之间夹入自动百叶窗。 “It’s not as simple as people think it is,” said Gordon Gill, an architect at Adrian Smith + Gordon Gill. He has helped design numerous skyscrapers, including a 1,000-meter tower in Saudi Arabia that will be the world’s tallest once completed. “I’m not a big fan of, ‘Aha, we found the answer: We’re just going to use less glass.’ I don’t believe in panaceas. Your entire process is about balance.” “这并不像人们想的那么简单，”阿德里安·史密斯+戈登·吉尔建筑事务所的建筑师戈登·吉尔说。他帮助设计了众多摩天大楼，包括沙特阿拉伯一座1000米高的塔楼，建成后将成为世界最高建筑。“我不太赞同那种‘啊哈，我们找到答案了：少用点玻璃就行’的想法。我不相信万灵药。你的整个过程都关乎平衡。” Most studies conclude that cutting down on glazing, as glass is sometimes called, does help reduce energy for cooling. A 2019 analysis of 1,000 American office buildings found that structures with larger window ratios had higher air-conditioning loads — though window size didn’t predict a building’s overall energy use. A research paper from Saudi Arabia concluded that glazing “should be minimized in hot regions,” with windows ideally amounting to 20 to 30 percent of the facade. 大多数研究得出结论，减少玻璃确实有助于降低冷却能耗。2019年对1000栋美国办公楼的分析发现，窗户比例越大的建筑，空调负荷越高——尽管窗户大小并不能预测建筑的整体能耗。沙特阿拉伯的一篇研究论文得出结论，在炎热地区“应尽量减少”玻璃的使用，理想情况下，窗户应占外立面的20%到30%。 But skyscrapers, of course, are so much more than objects meant to maximize efficiency. Big windows let in natural light, which limits the need for artificial lighting. 但摩天大楼当然不仅仅是为了最大限度提高能效而存在的。大窗户能引入自然光，从而减少对人工照明的需求。 They also help units sell. 它们也有助于房屋销售。 “默德卡118”是世界第二高的摩天大楼，为吉隆坡的天际线增添了一抹亮色。阿纳斯塔西娅·齐曼站在Oxley大楼的泳池旁，该建筑采用落地玻璃设计。 Ms. Zeeman, for example, had looked at seven or eight properties before walking into Oxley Towers, one of which is Kuala Lumpur’s sixth-tallest building. She’d moved from the Dutch countryside with her husband, who’d gotten an engineering job in the city. They saw the panorama and paid over their budget. 例如，齐曼女士在走进豪利大厦之前看过七八处房产，其中一栋是吉隆坡第六高的建筑。她和丈夫从荷兰乡村搬来，丈夫在这座城市找到了一份工程工作。他们看到全景后，以超出预算的价格买下了房子。 “To wake up with this view, it’s a completely different mood,” she said. “It inspires me to do more.” “每天清晨醒来就能看到这样的景色，心情完全不一样，”她说。“它激励我做更多事情。” ‘Beautiful to the eye’ “赏心悦目” Glass has helped give Malaysia the very thing its prime minister said he wanted three decades ago: buildings that evoke development and are “beautiful to the eye.” 玻璃帮助马来西亚实现了其总理30年前期盼的目标：既象征着发展又“赏心悦目”的建筑。 The country started in 1996 by completing the twin Petronas Towers, the tallest buildings in the world at the time. Then it kept going, constructing hundreds more skyscrapers — including two taller than Petronas. Malaysia, with just 35 million people, now has more buildings 200 meters or higher than any country but China, the United States and the United Arab Emirates. 马来西亚于1996年建成了双子塔，当时它们是世界最高建筑。从那以后，它继续建造了数百座摩天大楼，其中包括两座比双子塔更高的建筑。马来西亚只有3500万人口，如今其200米及以上高层建筑数量仅次于中国、美国和阿联酋，位居世界第四。 Some of them, particularly ones with top-end technology, have good energy efficiency numbers, said Sarly Adre Sarkum, an architect and the chief executive of Malaysia’s Green Building Index. But Mr. Sarkum said the overall quality of the towers is “still not so good.” He said that in Malaysia’s climate, extensive glass facades carry “significant energy consequences.” 其中一些建筑，尤其是采用尖端技术的建筑，能源效率指标相当不错，马来西亚绿色建筑指数首席执行官、建筑师萨利·阿德雷·萨尔库姆说。但他指出，这些高楼的整体质量“仍然不太理想”。在马来西亚的气候条件下，大面积使用玻璃幕墙会带来“显著的能源消耗问题”。 马来西亚绿色建筑指数首席执行官萨莉·阿德雷·萨库姆。吉隆坡的新建项目。 Roughly 60 percent of the building energy use in Malaysia stems from air-conditioning, Mr. Sarkum said. “When buyers purchase these, they think they get great views,” Mr. Sarkum said. “But you need to keep the curtains closed.” 萨尔库姆说，马来西亚约60%的建筑能耗来自空调。“买房的人觉得，这样可以欣赏到绝佳的风景，”他说。“但实际上，你得一直拉着窗帘。” The Oxley Towers, where Ms. Zeeman lives, represents one of the city’s heaviest uses of glass. Even the bathrooms next to the gym have floor-to-ceiling windows. 齐曼女士居住的奥克斯利大厦是这座城市玻璃使用量最大的建筑之一。甚至健身房旁边的卫生间也有落地窗。 The Oxley was designed by a firm founded by David Mizan Hashim, a self-described “idealist” who obtained his master’s degree from Harvard in 1986 and launched his company, Veritas, soon after. Veritas says it accepts only projects that aim for green certifications. 奥克斯利大厦由戴维·米赞·哈希姆创立的公司设计。哈希姆自称“理想主义者”，1986年在哈佛获得硕士学位，不久后创立了Veritas。该公司表示，只承接以获得绿色建筑认证为目标的项目。 But Dr. Hashim acknowledged that his idealism doesn’t always play out, given the trade-offs over aesthetics and performance. “This is the struggle of my life,” he said. 但哈希姆承认，考虑到建筑美观与性能之间需要作出取舍，他的理想主义并不总能付诸实践。“这是我一生都在应对的难题，”他说。 林立的玻璃摩天大楼是吉隆坡彰显现代感的一个方面。戴维·米赞·哈希姆（中）表示，在追求高效建筑与满足商业期望之间取得平衡“是我一生都在应对的难题”。 For one thing, developers of residential high rises don’t wind up paying the energy bills. “So there is less of an incentive for them to go all-out,” Dr. Hashim said. 其中一个问题是，住宅高楼的开发商最终并不需要支付能源账单。“因此，他们缺乏全力提高能效的动力，”哈希姆说。 The Singapore-based company that developed Oxley said in a sustainability report that it works “continuously” to improve the efficiency of its properties, and uses energy-efficient air-conditioning systems and motion-sensor lighting where possible. It says Oxley Towers have “high-quality glazing” that “reduces the need for extensive air-conditioning.” 开发奥克斯利大厦的新加坡公司在一份可持续发展报告中表示，公司“持续”致力于提高旗下物业的能源效率，并在条件允许的情况下使用节能空调系统和感应式照明。公司称，奥克斯利大厦采用了“高品质玻璃”，能够“减少对大量使用空调的需求”。 Even so, Dr. Hashim said, the building is “not as cutting-edge as it could be.” That’s because the development company wanted a relatively unadorned look, which removed the possibility of adding shading features. “That was an aesthetic choice,” Dr. Hashim said. 即便如此，哈希姆说，这栋建筑“没有达到它本可以有的前沿水平”。这是因为开发单位想要相对朴素的外观，因此无法增设遮阳设施。“那是出于美观作出的选择，”哈希姆说。 The development company, Oxley Holdings Limited, did not respond to a request for comment. 开发公司豪利控股没有回应置评请求。 The towers will likely obtain a silver rating from Malaysia’s rating index, the third-highest level, he said, though Dr. Hashim had hoped it could be gold. Ultimately, he said, “it is a building that is being sold.” 哈希姆说，这几栋大楼很可能获得马来西亚绿色建筑评级体系的银级认证，这是该体系的第三高等级，尽管他原本希望能达到金级。归根结底，他说，“这是一栋要拿来卖的楼”。 The power of air-conditioning 空调如何改变一切 The glass skyscraper became viable only with the advent of air-conditioning. 直到空调问世，玻璃摩天大楼才成为可能。 Before then, high rises were built primarily out of heavy masonry, with windows as little cutouts. That aesthetic now looks old-fashioned. But in a 2023 study comparing the energy efficiency of nine New York City high rises, the oldest skyscraper — the Chrysler Building, constructed in 1929 — was by far the best performer. 在那之前，高层建筑主要用厚重的砖石建造，窗户只是墙面上一个个小小的开口。这种建筑风格如今看起来已经过时。然而，2023年的一项研究比较了纽约市九栋高层建筑的能源效率，结果发现，其中历史最悠久的摩天大楼——建于1929年的克莱斯勒大厦——能效表现遥遥领先。 Even in Malaysia, the first modestly tall buildings looked as if they were in an almost defensive stance against the sun. 即使在马来西亚，最早的那些不算太高的高层建筑看起来也几乎像是在对太阳严防死守。 The 18-story parliament building of the 1960s, Malaysia’s tallest at the time, came wrapped in a honeycomb-like lattice. The Dayabumi Complex, built in the 1980s, had its windows shrouded behind an ornate white veil inspired by Islamic motifs. 1960年代的18层国会大厦是当时马来西亚最高的建筑，外面包裹着蜂窝状格栅。1980年代建成的达雅布米综合体，其窗户隐藏在受伊斯兰图案启发的华丽白色遮挡物后面。 Stellios Plainiotis, the chief executive of a facade consulting company in Kuala Lumpur, said Malaysia was “effectively experimenting with what a skyscraper for the tropics should look like.” Some of those ideas now feel “remarkably current,” he said. 吉隆坡一家外立面咨询公司首席执行官斯特利奥斯·普莱尼奥蒂斯说，马来西亚“实际上一直在试验热带摩天大楼应该是什么样子”。他说，其中一些想法现在感觉“非常入时”。 Critics of the all-glass approach say air-conditioning excused architects to ignore other design lessons about contending with heat. Those include techniques honed over centuries in warm environments, such as the white, sun-reflective facades of Greece or the open, traditional homes of Southeast Asia. 全玻璃的批评者说，空调让建筑师有借口忽视其他应对高温的设计经验。这些经验包括数百年在炎热环境中磨练出来的技术，比如希腊白色的反光外立面，或东南亚的开放式传统住宅。 马来西亚的200米及以上高层建筑数量仅次于中国、美国和阿联酋，位居世界第四。今年夏天的大多数日子里，马来西亚首都的室外气温都超过了32摄氏度。 “Our ancestors, they didn’t go to school. And yet they could build buildings that respond to the climate,” said Abdul Razak Bin Sapian, a professor of architecture at the International Islamic University Malaysia. “我们的祖先没有上过学。但他们能建造适应气候的建筑，”马来西亚国际伊斯兰大学建筑学教授阿卜杜勒·拉扎克·本·萨皮安说。 One such example can be seen from the upper floors of the Oxley: a neighborhood, just a half-mile away, that looks from above like a toy village. Surrounded by high rises, it is an island of one- and two-story homes, preserved almost by accident because of colonial-era laws that created an enclave for ethnic Malay ownership. 从豪利大厦的高处可以看到一个这样的例子：半英里外的一个街区，从上面看像玩具村庄。它被高楼环绕，是一两层住宅组成的岛屿，几乎像是偶然保留下来的，因为殖民时代的法律为马来族所有权创造了一块飞地。 That has left the neighborhood, Kampung Baru, as an architectural time capsule. People hang out in open-air restaurants under ceiling fans, and many homes have large overhangs that ward off the sun. Small windows are covered by horizontal louvers. 这使甘榜巴鲁街区成为一个建筑时间胶囊。人们在吊扇下的露天餐厅消遣，许多住宅有宽大的屋檐遮阳。小窗户被水平百叶窗覆盖。 在传统的甘榜巴鲁社区，在空调时代到来之前，建筑的设计旨在缓解酷热。贾米亚·凯索特在家中。 One of the oldest homes in the neighborhood belongs to Jamiyah Kesot, 71. Constructed of dark timber with a high-pitched roof, it relies on the cooling features from a different time. It is built on stilts, allowing airflow from below. Ms. Kesot’s monthly energy bill is around $15. She uses two floor fans and no air-conditioning. 该街区最古老的住宅之一属于71岁的贾米亚·凯索特。这栋房子由深色木材建造，屋顶高耸，依赖的是另一个时代的降温特性。房子有高脚，让空气从下方流通。凯索特每月的能源账单约15美元。她使用两台落地扇，不用空调。 “I don’t need it,” said Ms. Kesot, a grandmother of seven who worked on a Texas Instruments assembly line for 37 years before retiring in 2011. “我不需要空调，”凯索特说。她有七个孙辈，曾在得克萨斯仪器公司装配线上工作37年，2011年退休。 Most days last summer, the outdoor temperature rose into the 90s. And Ms. Kesot’s home, at least to an unacclimated visitor, still felt punishingly humid. But one afternoon a thunderstorm rolled in. Wind rippled through the louvers, flapping the curtains, and the home filled with fresh air. 去年夏天大多数日子，室外温度在摄氏32度以上。凯索特的家，至少对一个不适应的访客来说，仍然感觉闷热难耐。但一天下午，一场雷暴袭来。风穿过百叶窗，吹动窗帘，家中充满新鲜空气。 From her living room, as the thunder crackled, Ms. Kesot had no panoramic view of the soaring buildings all around her or the dramatic skies about Kuala Lumpur. For that, she’d have to go outside. 在客厅里，雷声噼啪作响，凯索特没有周围高耸建筑的那种全景视野，也看不到吉隆坡那动人心魄的天空。要看的话，她得走到外面去。 Chico Harlan是《纽约时报》的全球气候记者。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site
content: CHICO HARLAN, ZUNAIRA SAIEED 2026年10月30日 Ulet Ifansasti for The New York Times One thousand feet above city traffic, from her new 74th-floor apartment, Anastasia Zeeman has the kind of enchanting views that only floor-to-ceiling glass can offer. She looks out on a skyline and horizon where storms and sunsets play out like big-screen movies. 城市车流上方约300米处，阿纳斯塔西娅·齐曼在她位于74层的新公寓里欣赏着只有落地玻璃才能提供的迷人景色。她眺望天际线和地平线，风暴与日落交织的景象宛如大银幕电影般上演。 But Malaysia’s tropical sun sometimes delivers what Ms. Zeeman calls a “wall of heat” radiating from her windows. 但马来西亚的热带阳光有时会带来齐曼所说的“热墙”，从她的窗户辐射进来。 More than any other form of architecture, glass skyscrapers testify to the human desire for sweeping views and a sense of rising above the fray. In some of the world’s fastest developing places — Dubai, Mumbai, Jakarta, Kuala Lumpur — they have become city-defining showpieces, signaling sophistication and rising financial clout. 与其他任何建筑形式相比，玻璃摩天大楼最能体现人类对开阔视野的向往，以及凌驾于尘嚣之上的追求。在迪拜、孟买、雅加达、吉隆坡等全球发展最迅速的城市中，它们已成为定义城市风貌的标志性建筑，象征着精致和日益增强的金融影响力。 And yet glass tends to be ill-suited for keeping out the heat, and its overuse often makes buildings more energy intensive to cool. That’s fueling a debate about whether these symbols of modernity make sense in a world growing hotter because of climate change. 然而，玻璃往往不适合阻隔热量，其过度使用常常使建筑冷却所需能耗更高。这引发了一场辩论：在因气候变化而日益炎热的世界里，这些现代性的象征是否还有意义。 Some argue that the ambition and innovation that spawned the high-rise era can help modern skyscrapers fend off rising temperatures while maintaining the million-dollar views. Others say the all-glass aesthetic is at odds with the environmental goal of reducing greenhouse-gas emissions. They say it is time to rethink city skylines. 一些人认为，凭借催生摩天大楼时代的雄心和创新，现代摩天大楼能够在保持价值百万美元的壮丽景观同时抵御气温上升。另一些人说，全玻璃美学与减少温室气体排放的环境目标相悖。他们说，是时候对城市天际线进行重新思考了。 When he was New York City mayor in 2019, Bill de Blasio briefly floated the idea of banning the “glass and steel” structures altogether. Philip Oldfield, an Australian architecture scholar who wrote a book on sustainable high rises, calls the glass towers “environmentally criminal.” Ken Shuttleworth, a prominent British architect who three decades ago helped design London’s Gherkin building, now says he’d do it differently, without quite as much glass all the way around. 2019年担任纽约市长时，比尔·德布拉西奥曾短暂提出全面禁止“玻璃和钢铁”结构的想法。写过一本关于可持续高层建筑书籍的澳大利亚建筑学者菲利普·奥德菲尔德称，玻璃摩天楼“在环境上是犯罪”。30年前曾参与设计伦敦“小黄瓜”大楼的英国著名建筑师肯·沙特尔斯沃思表示，现在他会采用不同方案，不会四周都使用那么多玻璃。 “You really just need to have smaller windows,” said Mr. Shuttleworth. He said his approach to skyscraper design has changed as he’s come to realize that “we are burning a hole in the planet.” “你其实只需要把窗户做小一些，”沙特尔斯沃思说。他说，随着他逐渐意识到“我们正在把地球烧出一个洞”，他对摩天大楼设计的思路已经改变。 穿透科威特的浓雾。 伦敦著名“小黄瓜”大楼的建筑师之一表示，如果今天重新设计，他会减少玻璃的使用量。 Despite that criticism, the glass skyscraper’s appeal endures. 尽管有这些批评，玻璃摩天大楼的魅力依然不减。 The form, which originated in American cities like Chicago and New York, has now spread across China, the Middle East and Southeast Asia. Over the past decade, the world has constructed 25 times the number of buildings 200 meters (roughly 655 feet) or taller that it did in the 1980s, according to the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat. Some 91 percent of the world’s skyscrapers of that height have been built since the turn of the 21st century. 这种形式起源于芝加哥和纽约等美国城市，如今已传播到中国、中东和东南亚。根据高层建筑与城市人居委员会的数据，过去十年，全球建造的200米或更高建筑数量是1980年代的25倍。世界上约91%的这一高度摩天大楼是在进入21世纪以来建造的。 The “vast majority” have facades largely of glass, said Antony Wood, who was the president of that council until last year. 该委员会任期至去年的前主席安东尼·伍德说，“绝大多数”建筑的外立面主要是玻璃。 Proponents of glass-dominant design say this building spree can still be responsible if strategic choices are made. 支持玻璃为主设计方案的人士认为，只要做出战略选择，这种建筑热潮仍然可以做到环保。 Because the sun doesn’t hit a building equally from all directions, buildings can boost their energy efficiency simply with the right orientation. Architects can also add features like fins or undulations so less sunlight directly hits the glass. Stringing greenery on glass facades is also a trend. 因为太阳并非从所有方向均匀照射建筑，建筑只需通过合理的朝向设计，就能提高能源效率。建筑师还可以添加翅片或起伏等特征，减少阳光直射玻璃。在玻璃外立面上布置绿植也是一种趋势。 Glass can also be treated with gossamer-thin metallic coatings that reflect away radiation. Most buildings use several layers of glass to impede the heat. One high-end option involves sandwiching automated blinds between them. 玻璃还可以涂覆薄如蛛丝的金属涂层，以反射辐射热。大多数建筑使用多层玻璃来阻挡热量。一种高端选择是在玻璃之间夹入自动百叶窗。 “It’s not as simple as people think it is,” said Gordon Gill, an architect at Adrian Smith + Gordon Gill. He has helped design numerous skyscrapers, including a 1,000-meter tower in Saudi Arabia that will be the world’s tallest once completed. “I’m not a big fan of, ‘Aha, we found the answer: We’re just going to use less glass.’ I don’t believe in panaceas. Your entire process is about balance.” “这并不像人们想的那么简单，”阿德里安·史密斯+戈登·吉尔建筑事务所的建筑师戈登·吉尔说。他帮助设计了众多摩天大楼，包括 沙特阿拉伯一座1000米高的塔楼 ，建成后将成为世界最高建筑。“我不太赞同那种‘啊哈，我们找到答案了：少用点玻璃就行’的想法。我不相信万灵药。你的整个过程都关乎平衡。” Most studies conclude that cutting down on glazing, as glass is sometimes called, does help reduce energy for cooling. A 2019 analysis of 1,000 American office buildings found that structures with larger window ratios had higher air-conditioning loads — though window size didn’t predict a building’s overall energy use. A research paper from Saudi Arabia concluded that glazing “should be minimized in hot regions,” with windows ideally amounting to 20 to 30 percent of the facade. 大多数研究得出结论，减少玻璃确实有助于降低冷却能耗。2019年对1000栋美国办公楼的分析发现，窗户比例越大的建筑，空调负荷越高——尽管窗户大小并不能预测建筑的整体能耗。沙特阿拉伯的一篇研究论文得出结论，在炎热地区“应尽量减少”玻璃的使用，理想情况下，窗户应占外立面的20%到30%。 But skyscrapers, of course, are so much more than objects meant to maximize efficiency. Big windows let in natural light, which limits the need for artificial lighting. 但摩天大楼当然不仅仅是为了最大限度提高能效而存在的。大窗户能引入自然光，从而减少对人工照明的需求。 They also help units sell. 它们也有助于房屋销售。 “默德卡118”是世界第二高的摩天大楼，为吉隆坡的天际线增添了一抹亮色。 阿纳斯塔西娅·齐曼站在Oxley大楼的泳池旁，该建筑采用落地玻璃设计。 Ms. Zeeman, for example, had looked at seven or eight properties before walking into Oxley Towers, one of which is Kuala Lumpur’s sixth-tallest building. She’d moved from the Dutch countryside with her husband, who’d gotten an engineering job in the city. They saw the panorama and paid over their budget. 例如，齐曼女士在走进豪利大厦之前看过七八处房产，其中一栋是吉隆坡第六高的建筑。她和丈夫从荷兰乡村搬来，丈夫在这座城市找到了一份工程工作。他们看到全景后，以超出预算的价格买下了房子。 “To wake up with this view, it’s a completely different mood,” she said. “It inspires me to do more.” “每天清晨醒来就能看到这样的景色，心情完全不一样，”她说。“它激励我做更多事情。” ‘Beautiful to the eye’ “赏心悦目” Glass has helped give Malaysia the very thing its prime minister said he wanted three decades ago: buildings that evoke development and are “ beautiful to the eye .” 玻璃帮助马来西亚实现了其总理30年前期盼的目标：既象征着发展又“ 赏心悦目 ”的建筑。 The country started in 1996 by completing the twin Petronas Towers, the tallest buildings in the world at the time. Then it kept going, constructing hundreds more skyscrapers — including two taller than Petronas. Malaysia, with just 35 million people, now has more buildings 200 meters or higher than any country but China, the United States and the United Arab Emirates. 马来西亚于1996年建成了双子塔，当时它们是世界最高建筑。从那以后，它继续建造了数百座摩天大楼，其中包括两座比双子塔更高的建筑。马来西亚只有3500万人口，如今其200米及以上高层建筑数量仅次于中国、美国和阿联酋，位居世界第四。 Some of them, particularly ones with top-end technology, have good energy efficiency numbers, said Sarly Adre Sarkum, an architect and the chief executive of Malaysia’s Green Building Index. But Mr. Sarkum said the overall quality of the towers is “still not so good.” He said that in Malaysia’s climate, extensive glass facades carry “significant energy consequences.” 其中一些建筑，尤其是采用尖端技术的建筑，能源效率指标相当不错，马来西亚绿色建筑指数首席执行官、建筑师萨利·阿德雷·萨尔库姆说。但他指出，这些高楼的整体质量“仍然不太理想”。在马来西亚的气候条件下，大面积使用玻璃幕墙会带来“显著的能源消耗问题”。 马来西亚绿色建筑指数首席执行官萨莉·阿德雷·萨库姆。 吉隆坡的新建项目。 Roughly 60 percent of the building energy use in Malaysia stems from air-conditioning, Mr. Sarkum said. “When buyers purchase these, they think they get great views,” Mr. Sarkum said. “But you need to keep the curtains closed.” 萨尔库姆说，马来西亚约60%的建筑能耗来自空调。“买房的人觉得，这样可以欣赏到绝佳的风景，”他说。“但实际上，你得一直拉着窗帘。” The Oxley Towers, where Ms. Zeeman lives, represents one of the city’s heaviest uses of glass. Even the bathrooms next to the gym have floor-to-ceiling windows. 齐曼女士居住的奥克斯利大厦是这座城市玻璃使用量最大的建筑之一。甚至健身房旁边的卫生间也有落地窗。 The Oxley was designed by a firm founded by David Mizan Hashim, a self-described “idealist” who obtained his master’s degree from Harvard in 1986 and launched his company, Veritas, soon after. Veritas says it accepts only projects that aim for green certifications. 奥克斯利大厦由戴维·米赞·哈希姆创立的公司设计。哈希姆自称“理想主义者”，1986年在哈佛获得硕士学位，不久后创立了Veritas。该公司表示，只承接以获得绿色建筑认证为目标的项目。 But Dr. Hashim acknowledged that his idealism doesn’t always play out, given the trade-offs over aesthetics and performance. “This is the struggle of my life,” he said. 但哈希姆承认，考虑到建筑美观与性能之间需要作出取舍，他的理想主义并不总能付诸实践。“这是我一生都在应对的难题，”他说。 林立的玻璃摩天大楼是吉隆坡彰显现代感的一个方面。 戴维·米赞·哈希姆（中）表示，在追求高效建筑与满足商业期望之间取得平衡“是我一生都在应对的难题”。 For one thing, developers of residential high rises don’t wind up paying the energy bills. “So there is less of an incentive for them to go all-out,” Dr. Hashim said. 其中一个问题是，住宅高楼的开发商最终并不需要支付能源账单。“因此，他们缺乏全力提高能效的动力，”哈希姆说。 The Singapore-based company that developed Oxley said in a sustainability report that it works “continuously” to improve the efficiency of its properties, and uses energy-efficient air-conditioning systems and motion-sensor lighting where possible. It says Oxley Towers have “high-quality glazing” that “reduces the need for extensive air-conditioning.” 开发奥克斯利大厦的新加坡公司在一份可持续发展报告中表示，公司“持续”致力于提高旗下物业的能源效率，并在条件允许的情况下使用节能空调系统和感应式照明。公司称，奥克斯利大厦采用了“高品质玻璃”，能够“减少对大量使用空调的需求”。 Even so, Dr. Hashim said, the building is “not as cutting-edge as it could be.” That’s because the development company wanted a relatively unadorned look, which removed the possibility of adding shading features. “That was an aesthetic choice,” Dr. Hashim said. 即便如此，哈希姆说，这栋建筑“没有达到它本可以有的前沿水平”。这是因为开发单位想要相对朴素的外观，因此无法增设遮阳设施。“那是出于美观作出的选择，”哈希姆说。 The development company, Oxley Holdings Limited, did not respond to a request for comment. 开发公司豪利控股没有回应置评请求。 The towers will likely obtain a silver rating from Malaysia’s rating index, the third-highest level, he said, though Dr. Hashim had hoped it could be gold. Ultimately, he said, “it is a building that is being sold.” 哈希姆说，这几栋大楼很可能获得马来西亚绿色建筑评级体系的银级认证，这是该体系的第三高等级，尽管他原本希望能达到金级。归根结底，他说，“这是一栋要拿来卖的楼”。 The power of air-conditioning 空调如何改变一切 The glass skyscraper became viable only with the advent of air-conditioning. 直到空调问世，玻璃摩天大楼才成为可能。 Before then, high rises were built primarily out of heavy masonry, with windows as little cutouts. That aesthetic now looks old-fashioned. But in a 2023 study comparing the energy efficiency of nine New York City high rises, the oldest skyscraper — the Chrysler Building, constructed in 1929 — was by far the best performer. 在那之前，高层建筑主要用厚重的砖石建造，窗户只是墙面上一个个小小的开口。这种建筑风格如今看起来已经过时。然而，2023年的一项研究比较了纽约市九栋高层建筑的能源效率，结果发现，其中历史最悠久的摩天大楼——建于1929年的克莱斯勒大厦——能效表现遥遥领先。 Even in Malaysia, the first modestly tall buildings looked as if they were in an almost defensive stance against the sun. 即使在马来西亚，最早的那些不算太高的高层建筑看起来也几乎像是在对太阳严防死守。 The 18-story parliament building of the 1960s, Malaysia’s tallest at the time, came wrapped in a honeycomb-like lattice. The Dayabumi Complex, built in the 1980s, had its windows shrouded behind an ornate white veil inspired by Islamic motifs. 1960年代的18层国会大厦是当时马来西亚最高的建筑，外面包裹着蜂窝状格栅。1980年代建成的达雅布米综合体，其窗户隐藏在受伊斯兰图案启发的华丽白色遮挡物后面。 Stellios Plainiotis, the chief executive of a facade consulting company in Kuala Lumpur, said Malaysia was “effectively experimenting with what a skyscraper for the tropics should look like.” Some of those ideas now feel “remarkably current,” he said. 吉隆坡一家外立面咨询公司首席执行官斯特利奥斯·普莱尼奥蒂斯说，马来西亚“实际上一直在试验热带摩天大楼应该是什么样子”。他说，其中一些想法现在感觉“非常入时”。 Critics of the all-glass approach say air-conditioning excused architects to ignore other design lessons about contending with heat. Those include techniques honed over centuries in warm environments, such as the white, sun-reflective facades of Greece or the open, traditional homes of Southeast Asia. 全玻璃的批评者说，空调让建筑师有借口忽视其他应对高温的设计经验。这些经验包括数百年在炎热环境中磨练出来的技术，比如希腊白色的反光外立面，或东南亚的开放式传统住宅。 马来西亚的200米及以上高层建筑数量仅次于中国、美国和阿联酋，位居世界第四。 今年夏天的大多数日子里，马来西亚首都的室外气温都超过了32摄氏度。 “Our ancestors, they didn’t go to school. And yet they could build buildings that respond to the climate,” said Abdul Razak Bin Sapian, a professor of architecture at the International Islamic University Malaysia. “我们的祖先没有上过学。但他们能建造适应气候的建筑，”马来西亚国际伊斯兰大学建筑学教授阿卜杜勒·拉扎克·本·萨皮安说。 One such example can be seen from the upper floors of the Oxley: a neighborhood, just a half-mile away, that looks from above like a toy village. Surrounded by high rises, it is an island of one- and two-story homes, preserved almost by accident because of colonial-era laws that created an enclave for ethnic Malay ownership. 从豪利大厦的高处可以看到一个这样的例子：半英里外的一个街区，从上面看像玩具村庄。它被高楼环绕，是一两层住宅组成的岛屿，几乎像是偶然保留下来的，因为殖民时代的法律为马来族所有权创造了一块飞地。 That has left the neighborhood, Kampung Baru, as an architectural time capsule. People hang out in open-air restaurants under ceiling fans, and many homes have large overhangs that ward off the sun. Small windows are covered by horizontal louvers. 这使甘榜巴鲁街区成为一个建筑时间胶囊。人们在吊扇下的露天餐厅消遣，许多住宅有宽大的屋檐遮阳。小窗户被水平百叶窗覆盖。 在传统的甘榜巴鲁社区，在空调时代到来之前，建筑的设计旨在缓解酷热。 贾米亚·凯索特在家中。 One of the oldest homes in the neighborhood belongs to Jamiyah Kesot, 71. Constructed of dark timber with a high-pitched roof, it relies on the cooling features from a different time. It is built on stilts, allowing airflow from below. Ms. Kesot’s monthly energy bill is around $15. She uses two floor fans and no air-conditioning. 该街区最古老的住宅之一属于71岁的贾米亚·凯索特。这栋房子由深色木材建造，屋顶高耸，依赖的是另一个时代的降温特性。房子有高脚，让空气从下方流通。凯索特每月的能源账单约15美元。她使用两台落地扇，不用空调。 “I don’t need it,” said Ms. Kesot, a grandmother of seven who worked on a Texas Instruments assembly line for 37 years before retiring in 2011. “我不需要空调，”凯索特说。她有七个孙辈，曾在得克萨斯仪器公司装配线上工作37年，2011年退休。 Most days last summer, the outdoor temperature rose into the 90s. And Ms. Kesot’s home, at least to an unacclimated visitor, still felt punishingly humid. But one afternoon a thunderstorm rolled in. Wind rippled through the louvers, flapping the curtains, and the home filled with fresh air. 去年夏天大多数日子，室外温度在摄氏32度以上。凯索特的家，至少对一个不适应的访客来说，仍然感觉闷热难耐。但一天下午，一场雷暴袭来。风穿过百叶窗，吹动窗帘，家中充满新鲜空气。 From her living room, as the thunder crackled, Ms. Kesot had no panoramic view of the soaring buildings all around her or the dramatic skies about Kuala Lumpur. For that, she’d have to go outside. 在客厅里，雷声噼啪作响，凯索特没有周围高耸建筑的那种全景视野，也看不到吉隆坡那动人心魄的天空。要看的话，她得走到外面去。 Chico Harlan 是《纽约时报》的全球气候记者。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: 大选未产生明确获胜者，谁能最终成为以色列总理？
description: JOHNATAN REISS, ADINA RENNER, PABLO ROBLES2026年10月30日注：数据更新至美东时间10月29日5时。各党派必须赢得至少3.25%的全国选票才能进入拥有120个席位的以色列议会。来源：以色列中央选举委员会，经以色列公共广播公司转引。 Israel’s high-stakes parliamentary election on Tuesday produced no clear winner after most of the votes were counted. 以色列周二举行的关键议会选举在大部分选票统计完毕后，未能产生明确的获胜者。 That in itself was not unexpected — but there were nevertheless some surprises. 这本身并不出人意料——但确实出现了一些意外。 Mr. Netanyahu’s right-wing, populist party, Likud, outperformed many pre-election polls to become the largest party in Parliament, preliminary results show. It won fewer seats than in 2022, though, when the last national election was held. 初步结果显示，内塔尼亚胡领导的右翼民粹主义政党利库德集团表现好于许多选前民调，成为议会第一大党。不过，其赢得的席位少于2022年的上一次全国选举。 More noteworthy was the turnout by supporters of Israel’s Arab parties, which ended Election Day with a historic boost. 更值得注意的是以色列阿拉伯政党支持者的投票率，选举日结束时这一投票率实现了历史性增长。 Israel’s parliamentary system as a rule requires parties to find enough common ground to assemble a 61-seat majority bloc in Israel’s 120-seat Parliament. Over the years, that has produced some unlikely alliances — but also shaky, short-lived governments. 以色列议会制度通常要求政党达成足够多的共识，在120席的议会中组成61席的多数派阵营。多年来，这一制度促成了一些出人意料的联盟，但也催生了摇摇欲坠的短命政府。 In less than four years, from 2019 to 2022, Israelis were sent to the polls five times as parties failed to hold a majority together, or to form one in the first place. 2019年至2022年不到四年间，以色列人五次走向投票站，因为政党要么未能维持多数，要么从一开始就未能组成多数。 In the coming days, party leaders will be back at it again. With the provisional election results showing no bloc with a straightforward path to a coalition, it could mean bitter negotiations — or deadlock, with the very real possibility of another election. 未来几天，各党领导人将再次为此展开活动。临时选举结果显示，没有任何阵营拥有通向联盟的明确路径，这可能意味着激烈的谈判——或者僵局，而再次选举的可能性也是真实存在的。 Here’s how parties may align for Israelis to get a government and avoid another trip to the polls. 以下是各党可能如何组合，以便以色列人产生一个政府并避免再次投票。 Scenario 可能的情形 A historic Jewish-Arab alliance 历史性的犹太-阿拉伯联盟 For Mr. Netanyahu’s opponents, securing a majority increasingly appears to depend on support from at least some Arab lawmakers. 对内塔尼亚胡的反对者而言，要确立多数地位，似乎越来越多地取决于至少部分阿拉伯议员的支持。 If the opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot’s coalition were to include both Arab parties — the Joint List, an ideologically diverse alliance, and Raam, a pragmatic Islamist party — he would have a significant majority in Parliament. 如果反对派领导人加迪·艾森科特的联盟同时纳入两个阿拉伯政党——意识形态多元的“联合名单”和务实的伊斯兰主义政党“拉姆”——他将在议会中拥有显著多数。 Such a coalition would carry political risks. 这样的联盟将伴随政治风险。 Mr. Eisenkot has rejected alliances with parties that do not support Israel’s Jewish character or the defeat of militant group Hamas in the Gaza Strip. Many of his voters could see an alliance with Arab parties as a broken campaign promise, a liability for Mr. Eisenkot in a political landscape in which another election could be imminent. 艾森科特拒绝与不支持以色列的犹太属性、或不支持在加沙地带击败激进组织哈马斯的政党结盟。他的许多选民可能将与阿拉伯政党的联盟视为背弃竞选承诺，在可能很快再次选举的政治格局中，这对艾森科特而言是一个不利因素。 Another possibility for the Eisenkot bloc is to leave Arab lawmakers out of the coalition but secure their agreement to support a minority government. Such a government can take office as long as more lawmakers vote for it than against it, even if the parties that make it up hold fewer than 61 seats. 艾森科特阵营的另一种可能是将阿拉伯议员排除在联盟之外，但确保他们同意支持一个少数政府。只要支持票多于反对票，这样的政府即可就职，即便组成政府的政党所持席位不足61席。 For the Jewish anti-Netanyahu bloc, based on provisional results, that would mean support from at least six lawmakers from the Arab parties in the initial confidence vote. But it is unclear whether those parties would agree to support a government from which they would be excluded, or how sustainable such an arrangement would be. 根据目前暂时的结果，对犹太反内塔尼亚胡阵营而言，这意味着在首次信任投票中至少需要阿拉伯政党六名议员的支持。但这些政党是否会同意支持一个将自己排除在外的政府，以及这种安排能否持续，尚不清楚。 Scenario 情景 A unity government 团结政府 A unity government led by Mr. Netanyahu and Mr. Eisenkot could offer a different path to a clear majority. 由内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特共同领导的团结政府可能提供另一条通向明确多数的路径。 But such an alliance could prove uneasy for both leaders. 但这种联盟对两位领导人而言都可能并不安稳。 Mr. Eisenkot’s entire campaign focused on the urgent need to unseat Mr. Netanyahu, whom he called unfit to serve as prime minister. Mr. Netanyahu may not be keen to share power, or delegate significant authority, to his fierce rivals, potentially at the expense of longtime allies. 艾森科特的整个竞选活动聚焦于将内塔尼亚胡赶下台的紧迫性，他称后者不适合担任总理。内塔尼亚胡可能不愿与自己的激烈对手分享权力或授予其重要权限，而这可能以长期盟友为代价。 One possible unity government could bring together Mr. Netanyahu’s Likud party; Mr. Eisenkot’s Yashar party; Together, an alliance between the right-wing Naftali Bennett and the centrist Yair Lapid; and Yisrael Beiteinu, a right-wing party whose leader, Avigdor Liberman, broke with Mr. Netanyahu and has long been his rival on the right. 一种可能的团结政府是汇集内塔尼亚胡的利库德、艾森科特的亚沙尔党、右翼的纳夫塔利·贝内特与中间派的亚伊尔·拉皮德的“团结”联盟，以及右翼政党“以色列是我们的家园”——其领导人阿维格多·利伯曼已与内塔尼亚胡决裂，多年来一直是其在右翼的对手。 Preliminary results give such a bloc 66 seats, a clear governing majority, if a shaky one. 初步结果表明这样一个阵营有66席，构成明确的执政多数，尽管并不稳固。 Scenario 情景 Defections 倒戈 The coming weeks of political wrangling could open other paths to a government. Defections — not uncommon in Israeli politics — could allow one bloc to prevail at the expense of the other, a risk that exists in both political camps. 未来几周的政治角力可能打开通往政府的其他路径。倒戈——在以色列政治中并不罕见——可能让一个阵营以另一个阵营为代价占据上风，这一风险在两个阵营中都存在。 Parties that allied with Mr. Eisenkot during the campaign, or even individual lawmakers, could be coaxed into supporting a government led by Mr. Netanyahu. 竞选期间与艾森科特结盟的政党，甚至个别议员，可能被拉拢去支持内塔尼亚胡领导的政府。 For his part, Mr. Eisenkot could seek the support of the two ultra-Orthodox parties, which are longtime allies of Mr. Netanyahu but not without grievances against him. That might prove difficult, given that the opposition has long opposed military draft exemptions for ultra-Orthodox men. 艾森科特则可能寻求两个极端正统派政党的支持。这两个政党是内塔尼亚胡的长期盟友，但对他并非没有不满。鉴于反对派长期反对极端正统派男性的兵役豁免，这一努力可能十分困难。 Only one thing appears clear: However much Israelis may have regarded this election as a turning point for their country, neither Mr. Netanyahu nor his chief rival got the mandate they sought. 似乎只有一件事是清楚的：无论以色列人可能在多大程度上将此次选举视为国家的转折点，内塔尼亚胡及其主要对手都没有获得他们所寻求的授权。 Now, any path to power will require ideological compromises, uncomfortable alliances or both. Otherwise, it’s back to the voting booth. 如今，任何通往权力的道路都需要意识形态妥协、令人不安的联盟，或两者兼有。否则，就只能回到投票站。 Josh Holder对本文进行了补充报道。 Adina Renner是时报视觉化报道记者，常驻伦敦。 Pablo Robles是时报视觉化报道记者，运用数据、制图和图表来解释亚洲及世界各地发生的事件。他常驻首尔。 翻译：经雷 点击查看本文英文版。
content: JOHNATAN REISS, ADINA RENNER, PABLO ROBLES 2026年10月30日 注：数据更新至美东时间10月29日5时。各党派必须赢得至少3.25%的全国选票才能进入拥有120个席位的以色列议会。来源：以色列中央选举委员会，经以色列公共广播公司转引。 Israel’s high-stakes parliamentary election on Tuesday produced no clear winner after most of the votes were counted. 以色列周二举行的关键议会选举在大部分选票统计完毕后，未能产生明确的获胜者。 That in itself was not unexpected — but there were nevertheless some surprises. 这本身 并不出人意料 ——但确实出现了一些意外。 Mr. Netanyahu’s right-wing, populist party, Likud, outperformed many pre-election polls to become the largest party in Parliament, preliminary results show. It won fewer seats than in 2022, though, when the last national election was held. 初步结果显示，内塔尼亚胡领导的右翼民粹主义政党利库德集团表现好于许多选前民调，成为议会第一大党。不过，其赢得的席位少于2022年的上一次全国选举。 More noteworthy was the turnout by supporters of Israel’s Arab parties , which ended Election Day with a historic boost. 更值得注意的是 以色列阿拉伯政党支持者的投票率 ，选举日结束时这一投票率实现了历史性增长。 Israel’s parliamentary system as a rule requires parties to find enough common ground to assemble a 61-seat majority bloc in Israel’s 120-seat Parliament. Over the years, that has produced some unlikely alliances — but also shaky, short-lived governments. 以色列议会制度通常要求政党达成足够多的共识，在120席的议会中组成61席的多数派阵营。多年来，这一制度促成了一些出人意料的联盟，但也催生了摇摇欲坠的短命政府。 In less than four years, from 2019 to 2022, Israelis were sent to the polls five times as parties failed to hold a majority together, or to form one in the first place. 2019年至2022年不到四年间，以色列人五次走向投票站，因为政党要么未能维持多数，要么从一开始就未能组成多数。 In the coming days, party leaders will be back at it again. With the provisional election results showing no bloc with a straightforward path to a coalition, it could mean bitter negotiations — or deadlock, with the very real possibility of another election. 未来几天，各党领导人将再次为此展开活动。临时选举结果显示，没有任何阵营拥有通向联盟的明确路径，这可能意味着激烈的谈判——或者僵局，而再次选举的可能性也是真实存在的。 Here’s how parties may align for Israelis to get a government and avoid another trip to the polls. 以下是各党可能如何组合，以便以色列人产生一个政府并避免再次投票。 Scenario 可能的情形 A historic Jewish-Arab alliance 历史性的犹太-阿拉伯联盟 For Mr. Netanyahu’s opponents, securing a majority increasingly appears to depend on support from at least some Arab lawmakers. 对内塔尼亚胡的反对者而言，要确立多数地位，似乎越来越多地取决于至少部分阿拉伯议员的支持。 If the opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot’s coalition were to include both Arab parties — the Joint List, an ideologically diverse alliance, and Raam, a pragmatic Islamist party — he would have a significant majority in Parliament. 如果反对派领导人加迪·艾森科特的联盟同时纳入两个阿拉伯政党——意识形态多元的“联合名单”和务实的伊斯兰主义政党“拉姆”——他将在议会中拥有显著多数。 Such a coalition would carry political risks. 这样的联盟将伴随政治风险。 Mr. Eisenkot has rejected alliances with parties that do not support Israel’s Jewish character or the defeat of militant group Hamas in the Gaza Strip. Many of his voters could see an alliance with Arab parties as a broken campaign promise, a liability for Mr. Eisenkot in a political landscape in which another election could be imminent. 艾森科特拒绝与不支持以色列的犹太属性、或不支持在加沙地带击败激进组织哈马斯的政党结盟。他的许多选民可能将与阿拉伯政党的联盟视为背弃竞选承诺，在可能很快再次选举的政治格局中，这对艾森科特而言是一个不利因素。 Another possibility for the Eisenkot bloc is to leave Arab lawmakers out of the coalition but secure their agreement to support a minority government. Such a government can take office as long as more lawmakers vote for it than against it, even if the parties that make it up hold fewer than 61 seats. 艾森科特阵营的另一种可能是将阿拉伯议员排除在联盟之外，但确保他们同意支持一个少数政府。只要支持票多于反对票，这样的政府即可就职，即便组成政府的政党所持席位不足61席。 For the Jewish anti-Netanyahu bloc, based on provisional results, that would mean support from at least six lawmakers from the Arab parties in the initial confidence vote. But it is unclear whether those parties would agree to support a government from which they would be excluded, or how sustainable such an arrangement would be. 根据目前暂时的结果，对犹太反内塔尼亚胡阵营而言，这意味着在首次信任投票中至少需要阿拉伯政党六名议员的支持。但这些政党是否会同意支持一个将自己排除在外的政府，以及这种安排能否持续，尚不清楚。 Scenario 情景 A unity government 团结政府 A unity government led by Mr. Netanyahu and Mr. Eisenkot could offer a different path to a clear majority. 由内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特共同领导的团结政府可能提供另一条通向明确多数的路径。 But such an alliance could prove uneasy for both leaders. 但这种联盟对两位领导人而言都可能并不安稳。 Mr. Eisenkot’s entire campaign focused on the urgent need to unseat Mr. Netanyahu, whom he called unfit to serve as prime minister. Mr. Netanyahu may not be keen to share power, or delegate significant authority, to his fierce rivals, potentially at the expense of longtime allies. 艾森科特的整个竞选活动聚焦于将内塔尼亚胡赶下台的紧迫性，他称后者不适合担任总理。内塔尼亚胡可能不愿与自己的激烈对手分享权力或授予其重要权限，而这可能以长期盟友为代价。 One possible unity government could bring together Mr. Netanyahu’s Likud party; Mr. Eisenkot’s Yashar party; Together, an alliance between the right-wing Naftali Bennett and the centrist Yair Lapid; and Yisrael Beiteinu, a right-wing party whose leader, Avigdor Liberman, broke with Mr. Netanyahu and has long been his rival on the right. 一种可能的团结政府是汇集内塔尼亚胡的利库德、艾森科特的亚沙尔党、右翼的纳夫塔利·贝内特与中间派的亚伊尔·拉皮德的“团结”联盟，以及右翼政党“以色列是我们的家园”——其领导人阿维格多·利伯曼已与内塔尼亚胡决裂，多年来一直是其在右翼的对手。 Preliminary results give such a bloc 66 seats, a clear governing majority, if a shaky one. 初步结果表明这样一个阵营有66席，构成明确的执政多数，尽管并不稳固。 Scenario 情景 Defections 倒戈 The coming weeks of political wrangling could open other paths to a government. Defections — not uncommon in Israeli politics — could allow one bloc to prevail at the expense of the other, a risk that exists in both political camps. 未来几周的政治角力可能打开通往政府的其他路径。倒戈——在以色列政治中并不罕见——可能让一个阵营以另一个阵营为代价占据上风，这一风险在两个阵营中都存在。 Parties that allied with Mr. Eisenkot during the campaign, or even individual lawmakers, could be coaxed into supporting a government led by Mr. Netanyahu. 竞选期间与艾森科特结盟的政党，甚至个别议员，可能被拉拢去支持内塔尼亚胡领导的政府。 For his part, Mr. Eisenkot could seek the support of the two ultra-Orthodox parties, which are longtime allies of Mr. Netanyahu but not without grievances against him. That might prove difficult, given that the opposition has long opposed military draft exemptions for ultra-Orthodox men. 艾森科特则可能寻求两个极端正统派政党的支持。这两个政党是内塔尼亚胡的长期盟友，但对他并非没有不满。鉴于反对派长期反对极端正统派男性的兵役豁免，这一努力可能十分困难。 Only one thing appears clear: However much Israelis may have regarded this election as a turning point for their country, neither Mr. Netanyahu nor his chief rival got the mandate they sought. 似乎只有一件事是清楚的：无论以色列人可能在多大程度上将此次选举视为国家的转折点，内塔尼亚胡及其主要对手都没有获得他们所寻求的授权。 Now, any path to power will require ideological compromises, uncomfortable alliances or both. Otherwise, it’s back to the voting booth. 如今，任何通往权力的道路都需要意识形态妥协、令人不安的联盟，或两者兼有。否则，就只能回到投票站。 Josh Holder对本文进行了补充报道。 Adina Renner 是时报视觉化报道记者，常驻伦敦。 Pablo Robles 是时报视觉化报道记者，运用数据、制图和图表来解释亚洲及世界各地发生的事件。他常驻首尔。 翻译：经雷 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 孙悟空爱上林黛玉：中国AI短剧怎么成了“不当婚恋”
description: TIFFANY MAY2026年10月30日一段人工智能生成视频的画面截图，画面中的孙悟空和林黛玉分别出自中国古典名著《西游记》和《红楼梦》。这两部作品均于上世纪80年代被改编成电视剧。 In wholesome videos that have delighted the Chinese internet in recent weeks, the Monkey King in a yellow martial arts outfit and a maiden swathed in embroidered silks walk hand in hand. They frolic on sandy beaches and lush forest trails. They ride roller coasters and sample ice cream in a lantern-lit night market. 近几周，一系列温馨治愈的视频在中国互联网上引发热议。视频中，身穿黄色练功服的孙悟空与一位身披绣花绸缎的少女手牵着手，在沙滩和郁郁葱葱的林间小道上嬉戏。他们一起坐过山车，还在灯笼点亮的夜市里品尝冰淇淋。 The unlikely couple are Sun Wukong and Lin Daiyu, who hail from “Journey to the West” and “Dream of the Red Chamber,” classic Chinese novels that were turned into television shows in the 1980s. 这对意想不到的情侣是孙悟空和林黛玉，分别来自中国古典名著《西游记》和《红楼梦》，它们都在上世纪80年代被改编成电视剧。 The pair had never met in literature — or onscreen — until now. Their love story has been concocted by fans, some using artificial intelligence and some splicing old TV footage together. 此前，这两个人物从未在文学作品中或荧屏上相遇。他们的爱情故事由粉丝杜撰，有人使用人工智能，有人则把老版电视剧的片段剪辑在一起。 While they are popular with audiences in China, the videos have attracted the attention of the authorities, who believe they take too much creative license by bringing characters from disparate worlds together. 这些视频虽然受到中国观众的欢迎，却也引起了当局的注意。他们认为，将来自不同世界的人物放在一起，太过天马行空。 An editorial this month in People’s Daily, a Communist Party mouthpiece, acknowledged the appeal of rewriting the destiny of the characters, but said it risked eroding the meaning of the original stories, which are considered among the four most important Chinese classical novels. The editorial called for red lines to be drawn over videos depicting “malicious alterations that ridicule heroes.” 本月，中共机关报《人民日报》发表评论文章，承认改写人物命运具有吸引力，但同时警告，这可能损害原著的精神内核。《西游记》和《红楼梦》位列中国四大古典名著。评论呼吁划定红线，禁止那些“调侃英雄……的恶意篡改”视频。 Citing a government directive to remove A.I. animations that “seriously violate” the spirit of original works of classical literature and their characters, platforms said in October that they had taken down thousands of videos featuring the Monkey King and Lin Daiyu as a couple, one citing “improper romantic associations” between them. 根据政府要求清理“扭曲”原著精神、颠覆角色设定的AI魔改视频的指令，多家网络平台在10月表示，已下架数千条将孙悟空和林黛玉塑造成情侣的视频。其中一家平台称，两人之间存在“不当婚恋关联”。 The two 1980s televised adaptations were the childhood staples of a generation of Chinese millennials, and the characters are beloved for being misfits unbound by convention. The novels have also been reinterpreted into films and operas. 这两部20世纪80年代的电视剧改编作品是中国千禧一代的童年记忆，剧中人物因不循常规、不受世俗束缚的性格深受喜爱。两部原著小说也曾多次被改编成电影和戏曲。 Sun Wukong, the Monkey King from “Journey of the West,” was the irrepressible companion of a guileless monk seeking nirvana. He often found himself in trouble with the gods. 《西游记》中的美猴王孙悟空是一个不受约束的角色，陪伴着一位天真淳朴的僧人踏上追求涅槃的旅程。他常常与天庭众神发生冲突。 Lin Daiyu was an orphaned girl who had been taken in by wealthy relations in “Dream of the Red Chamber.” Sentimental and sickly, she was prone to sulky ripostes. Ultimately, she died of a broken heart after her lover was married off to another woman. 《红楼梦》中的林黛玉自幼失去双亲，被有钱的亲戚收养。她多愁善感、体弱多病，常常以带着怨气的言语反唇相讥。最终，她深爱的人被安排迎娶另一名女子，而她心碎而死。 Liang Ge, a lecturer in sociology at the University of Manchester in Britain, said that the Chinese government demanded a reverential interpretation of the classics and, while the novels had always been rewritten, these retellings seemed to have crossed that line. 英国曼彻斯特大学社会学讲师葛亮表示，中国政府要求人们以尊崇的态度诠释经典作品。尽管这些小说历来不断被改编，但这些再创作似乎越过了那条界限。 The use of the phrase “improper romantic association” by the video platform Kuaishou was telling, the academic added, saying that the authorities seemed concerned by “unauthorized authorship of intimacy at scale.” 葛亮还说，视频平台快手使用“不当婚恋关联”这一说法颇能说明问题。在他看来，当局似乎担心的是“大规模未经授权地创作亲密关系叙事”。 Some adaptations of the classics have been encouraged by the Communist Party. China’s leader, Xi Jinping, has urged a revival of traditional culture, saying that classic literature is part of the foundation of modern Chinese identity, along with revolutionary heroes. The blockbuster video game, “Black Myth: Wukong,” with hyper-realistic depictions also drawn from “Journey of the West,” was hailed as such a soft power triumph that the tourism authorities in Shanxi Province released a promotional video featuring landmarks that appeared in the game. 一些经典改编作品得到了共产党的鼓励。中国领导人习近平一直呼吁复兴传统文化，称古典文学与革命英雄一道，构成现代中国身份认同的基础。采用高度逼真的视觉呈现、同样取材于《西游记》的现象级电子游戏《黑神话：悟空》被誉为软实力的一大胜利，以至于山西省旅游部门发布了一段推广视频，展示游戏中出现的当地名胜古迹。 Yucong Hao, an assistant professor of Asian studies at Vanderbilt University, said in an email that the freedom to reinterpret Chinese history, mythology and classics remained bounded by “ideological correctness.” 范德堡大学亚洲研究助理教授郝宇骢透过电子邮件表示，重新诠释中国历史、神话和经典的自由仍受“意识形态正确性”的约束。 “The boundary between telling China’s stories well and telling them in ways that may be deemed subversive is often ambiguous,” she added. 她还说：“讲好中国故事以及可能被视为颠覆性的方式讲述中国故事，二者之间的界限往往模糊不清。” In January, the National Radio and Television Administration launched a campaign to remove A.I. animations that it said maligned revolutionary heroes, presented counterfactual history and misrepresented the spirit of characters from classic literature. 今年1月，国家广播电视总局启动一项整治行动，清理其称为诋毁革命英雄、歪曲历史事实、歪曲古典文学人物精神的AI魔改视频。 Social media and video streaming apps, including WeChat and Douyin, said in October that they had deleted A.I.-generated videos referencing classical literature that violate the rules. 包括微信和抖音在内的社交媒体及视频平台在10月表示，已删除违反相关规定、涉及古典文学作品的人工智能生成视频。 Afra Wang, a technology writer and cultural critic from China, said that the Lin Daiyu and Monkey King pairing was so popular “because of how different those two characters are, and at the same time, how deeply those two character are baked in the psyche of the generation.” 来自中国的科技作者和文化评论人士阿芙拉·王（音）表示，林黛玉和孙悟空这对组合之所以如此受欢迎，“是因为这两个人物有着天壤之别，同时又都深深植根于这一代人的集体记忆之中”。 Viewers seemed to enjoy the characters finding happiness together and seeing Lin Daiyu finally content, Ms. Wang said. The most liked comment under the People’s Daily editorial was: “May all great people have great lives. But reality is often so cruel.” Even the Guangzhou Railway posted a commercial comparing its relationship with customers to the chemistry between the pair. 她说，观众似乎很喜欢看到这两个人物在一起获得幸福，尤其是看到林黛玉终于过上称心如意的生活。《人民日报》那篇评论下获赞最多的一条评论写道：“愿所有美好的人都能有美好的人生。但现实往往如此残酷。”就连广州铁路部门也发布了一则广告，将其与乘客之间的关系比作孙悟空与林黛玉之间的默契。 Internet users have largely mocked the removal of the videos. One joked that all relationships that make women happy are labeled “inappropriate romantic associations.” 对于这些视频遭到下架，网民大多报以嘲讽。有人开玩笑说，凡是能让女性感到幸福的关系，都会被贴上“不当恋爱关系”的标签。 Eileen Chengyin Chow, a Sinologist at Duke University, said that with Mao Zedong identifying himself as a havoc-wreaking Monkey King in 1961, reinterpreting the canon was a political exercise dating back to the early days of the People’s Republic of China. 杜克大学汉学家周成荫表示，早在1961年，毛泽东就曾自比大闹天宫的孙悟空。这说明，重新诠释经典作品作为一种政治行为，可以追溯到中华人民共和国成立初期。 “Fans feel — rightly so — that it is very much in their rights to reinvent the classics,” she wrote in an email. “After all, ‘who doesn’t want Daiyu to be happy?’ seems to be the most popular sentiment!” 她在电子邮件中写道：“粉丝们觉得——而且理直气壮地觉得，他们完全有权重新演绎经典。毕竟，‘谁不希望黛玉幸福呢’似乎是最普遍的心声！” Siyi Zhao自北京对本文有研究贡献。 Tiffany May是时报驻香港记者，报道香港和更广泛地区的政治、商业和文化议题。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
content: TIFFANY MAY 2026年10月30日 一段人工智能生成视频的画面截图，画面中的孙悟空和林黛玉分别出自中国古典名著《西游记》和《红楼梦》。这两部作品均于上世纪80年代被改编成电视剧。 In wholesome videos that have delighted the Chinese internet in recent weeks, the Monkey King in a yellow martial arts outfit and a maiden swathed in embroidered silks walk hand in hand. They frolic on sandy beaches and lush forest trails. They ride roller coasters and sample ice cream in a lantern-lit night market. 近几周，一系列温馨治愈的视频在中国互联网上引发热议。视频中，身穿黄色练功服的孙悟空与一位身披绣花绸缎的少女手牵着手，在沙滩和郁郁葱葱的林间小道上嬉戏。他们一起坐过山车，还在灯笼点亮的夜市里品尝冰淇淋。 The unlikely couple are Sun Wukong and Lin Daiyu, who hail from “Journey to the West” and “Dream of the Red Chamber,” classic Chinese novels that were turned into television shows in the 1980s. 这对意想不到的情侣是孙悟空和林黛玉，分别来自中国古典名著《西游记》和《红楼梦》，它们都在上世纪80年代被改编成电视剧。 The pair had never met in literature — or onscreen — until now. Their love story has been concocted by fans, some using artificial intelligence and some splicing old TV footage together. 此前，这两个人物从未在文学作品中或荧屏上相遇。他们的爱情故事由粉丝杜撰，有人使用人工智能，有人则把老版电视剧的片段剪辑在一起。 While they are popular with audiences in China, the videos have attracted the attention of the authorities, who believe they take too much creative license by bringing characters from disparate worlds together. 这些视频虽然受到中国观众的欢迎，却也引起了当局的注意。他们认为，将来自不同世界的人物放在一起，太过天马行空。 An editorial this month in People’s Daily, a Communist Party mouthpiece, acknowledged the appeal of rewriting the destiny of the characters, but said it risked eroding the meaning of the original stories, which are considered among the four most important Chinese classical novels. The editorial called for red lines to be drawn over videos depicting “malicious alterations that ridicule heroes.” 本月，中共机关报《人民日报》发表评论文章，承认改写人物命运具有吸引力，但同时警告，这可能损害原著的精神内核。《西游记》和《红楼梦》位列中国四大古典名著。评论呼吁划定红线，禁止那些“调侃英雄……的恶意篡改”视频。 Citing a government directive to remove A.I. animations that “seriously violate” the spirit of original works of classical literature and their characters, platforms said in October that they had taken down thousands of videos featuring the Monkey King and Lin Daiyu as a couple, one citing “improper romantic associations” between them. 根据政府要求清理“扭曲”原著精神、颠覆角色设定的AI魔改视频的指令，多家网络平台在10月表示，已下架数千条将孙悟空和林黛玉塑造成情侣的视频。其中一家平台称，两人之间存在“不当婚恋关联”。 The two 1980s televised adaptations were the childhood staples of a generation of Chinese millennials, and the characters are beloved for being misfits unbound by convention. The novels have also been reinterpreted into films and operas. 这两部20世纪80年代的电视剧改编作品是中国千禧一代的童年记忆，剧中人物因不循常规、不受世俗束缚的性格深受喜爱。两部原著小说也曾多次被改编成电影和戏曲。 Sun Wukong, the Monkey King from “Journey of the West,” was the irrepressible companion of a guileless monk seeking nirvana. He often found himself in trouble with the gods. 《西游记》中的美猴王孙悟空是一个不受约束的角色，陪伴着一位天真淳朴的僧人踏上追求涅槃的旅程。他常常与天庭众神发生冲突。 Lin Daiyu was an orphaned girl who had been taken in by wealthy relations in “Dream of the Red Chamber.” Sentimental and sickly, she was prone to sulky ripostes. Ultimately, she died of a broken heart after her lover was married off to another woman. 《红楼梦》中的林黛玉自幼失去双亲，被有钱的亲戚收养。她多愁善感、体弱多病，常常以带着怨气的言语反唇相讥。最终，她深爱的人被安排迎娶另一名女子，而她心碎而死。 Liang Ge, a lecturer in sociology at the University of Manchester in Britain, said that the Chinese government demanded a reverential interpretation of the classics and, while the novels had always been rewritten, these retellings seemed to have crossed that line. 英国曼彻斯特大学社会学讲师葛亮表示，中国政府要求人们以尊崇的态度诠释经典作品。尽管这些小说历来不断被改编，但这些再创作似乎越过了那条界限。 The use of the phrase “improper romantic association” by the video platform Kuaishou was telling, the academic added, saying that the authorities seemed concerned by “unauthorized authorship of intimacy at scale.” 葛亮还说，视频平台快手使用“不当婚恋关联”这一说法颇能说明问题。在他看来，当局似乎担心的是“大规模未经授权地创作亲密关系叙事”。 Some adaptations of the classics have been encouraged by the Communist Party. China’s leader, Xi Jinping, has urged a revival of traditional culture, saying that classic literature is part of the foundation of modern Chinese identity, along with revolutionary heroes. The blockbuster video game, “ Black Myth: Wukong ,” with hyper-realistic depictions also drawn from “Journey of the West,” was hailed as such a soft power triumph that the tourism authorities in Shanxi Province released a promotional video featuring landmarks that appeared in the game. 一些经典改编作品得到了共产党的鼓励。中国领导人习近平一直呼吁复兴传统文化，称古典文学与革命英雄一道，构成现代中国身份认同的基础。采用高度逼真的视觉呈现、同样取材于《西游记》的现象级电子游戏 《黑神话：悟空》 被誉为软实力的一大胜利，以至于山西省旅游部门发布了一段 推广视频 ，展示游戏中出现的当地名胜古迹。 Yucong Hao, an assistant professor of Asian studies at Vanderbilt University, said in an email that the freedom to reinterpret Chinese history, mythology and classics remained bounded by “ideological correctness.” 范德堡大学亚洲研究助理教授郝宇骢透过电子邮件表示，重新诠释中国历史、神话和经典的自由仍受“意识形态正确性”的约束。 “The boundary between telling China’s stories well and telling them in ways that may be deemed subversive is often ambiguous,” she added. 她还说：“讲好中国故事以及可能被视为颠覆性的方式讲述中国故事，二者之间的界限往往模糊不清。” In January, the National Radio and Television Administration launched a campaign to remove A.I. animations that it said maligned revolutionary heroes, presented counterfactual history and misrepresented the spirit of characters from classic literature. 今年1月，国家广播电视总局启动一项 整治行动 ，清理其称为诋毁革命英雄、歪曲历史事实、歪曲古典文学人物精神的AI魔改视频。 Social media and video streaming apps, including WeChat and Douyin, said in October that they had deleted A.I.-generated videos referencing classical literature that violate the rules. 包括微信和抖音在内的社交媒体及视频平台在10月表示，已删除违反相关规定、涉及古典文学作品的人工智能生成视频。 Afra Wang, a technology writer and cultural critic from China, said that the Lin Daiyu and Monkey King pairing was so popular “because of how different those two characters are, and at the same time, how deeply those two character are baked in the psyche of the generation.” 来自中国的科技作者和文化评论人士阿芙拉·王（音）表示，林黛玉和孙悟空这对组合之所以如此受欢迎，“是因为这两个人物有着天壤之别，同时又都深深植根于这一代人的集体记忆之中”。 Viewers seemed to enjoy the characters finding happiness together and seeing Lin Daiyu finally content, Ms. Wang said. The most liked comment under the People’s Daily editorial was: “May all great people have great lives. But reality is often so cruel.” Even the Guangzhou Railway posted a commercial comparing its relationship with customers to the chemistry between the pair. 她说，观众似乎很喜欢看到这两个人物在一起获得幸福，尤其是看到林黛玉终于过上称心如意的生活。《人民日报》那篇评论下获赞最多的一条评论写道：“愿所有美好的人都能有美好的人生。但现实往往如此残酷。”就连广州铁路部门也发布了一则 广告 ，将其与乘客之间的关系比作孙悟空与林黛玉之间的默契。 Internet users have largely mocked the removal of the videos. One joked that all relationships that make women happy are labeled “inappropriate romantic associations.” 对于这些视频遭到下架，网民大多报以嘲讽。有人开玩笑说，凡是能让女性感到幸福的关系，都会被贴上“不当恋爱关系”的标签。 Eileen Chengyin Chow, a Sinologist at Duke University, said that with Mao Zedong identifying himself as a havoc-wreaking Monkey King in 1961, reinterpreting the canon was a political exercise dating back to the early days of the People’s Republic of China. 杜克大学汉学家周成荫表示，早在1961年， 毛泽东就曾自比大闹天宫的孙悟空 。这说明，重新诠释经典作品作为一种政治行为，可以追溯到中华人民共和国成立初期。 “Fans feel — rightly so — that it is very much in their rights to reinvent the classics,” she wrote in an email. “After all, ‘who doesn’t want Daiyu to be happy?’ seems to be the most popular sentiment!” 她在电子邮件中写道：“粉丝们觉得——而且理直气壮地觉得，他们完全有权重新演绎经典。毕竟，‘谁不希望黛玉幸福呢’似乎是最普遍的心声！” Siyi Zhao自北京对本文有研究贡献。 Tiffany May 是时报驻香港记者，报道香港和更广泛地区的政治、商业和文化议题。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 特朗普帮助博索纳罗逃离巴西前往美国
description: 黄安伟, ANA LONOVA, HAMED ALEAZIZ, TYLER PAGER2026年10月30日弗拉维奥·博索纳罗周三抵达迈阿密附近的奥帕洛卡机场。 Ricardo Arduengo/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images Flávio Bolsonaro, the Brazilian presidential candidate who faces multiple criminal investigations, is staying in Florida on a temporary status that was given following orders by President Trump, and will likely be granted permanent residency later, U.S. officials said. 美国官员表示，面临多项刑事调查的巴西总统候选人弗拉维奥·博索纳罗目前以特朗普总统下令授予的临时身份滞留佛罗里达州，并有望随后获得永久居留权。 Mr. Bolsonaro fled Brazil after losing an election this week. U.S. border agents allowed him and his family to enter the United States on what is called parole, usually given for humanitarian reasons, after they landed in Miami on a private jet on Wednesday morning, a U.S. official said that day. 博索纳罗本周竞选失败后逃离巴西。一名美国官员当天说，周三上午，博索纳罗及其家人乘坐私人飞机抵达迈阿密后，美国边境人员允许他们以所谓“暂准入境”身份入境，这种身份通常出于人道主义原因授予。 The jet had been arranged by a White House official. President Trump said later that afternoon that Mr. Bolsonaro had been given “a pass” to enter the country. 这架飞机由一名白宫官员安排。特朗普总统当天下午晚些时候说，博索纳罗获得了入境美国的“通行许可”。 The White House and the State Department referred questions about Mr. Bolsonaro’s parole status and Mr. Trump’s involvement to the Department of Homeland Security. That agency said Mr. Bolsonaro and his family “were met and inspected by U.S. Customs and Border Protection in accordance with applicable immigration laws and procedures. At the conclusion of the inspection, Mr. Bolsonaro and his accompanying family members were released.” 白宫和国务院将有关博索纳罗暂准入境身份及特朗普参与的问题转给国土安全部。国土安全部表示，博索纳罗及其家人“依照适用的移民法律和程序，接受了美国海关与边境保护局的接待和检查。检查结束后，博索纳罗及其随行家庭成员被放行”。 A public U.S. government record suggests that Mr. Bolsonaro presented a canceled Brazilian diplomatic passport on arrival, according to a review by The New York Times. The record lists a document with a number issued in Brazil that public disclosures show is linked to Mr. Bolsonaro’s diplomatic passport. 《纽约时报》查阅的一份美国政府公开记录显示，博索纳罗抵达时出示了一本已作废的巴西外交护照。该记录列出一个在巴西签发的证件编号，公开披露信息显示该号码与博索纳罗的外交护照有关。 The State Department said through an official on Tuesday that it planned to issue visas to Mr. Bolsonaro and his family allowing them to enter the country. The White House said the same thing that day, citing an administration official. 国务院周二通过一名官员表示，计划向博索纳罗及其家人发放签证，允许他们入境美国。白宫当天也援引一名政府官员的话作出同样表示。 The U.S. government grants parole status to people “for urgent humanitarian reasons or significant public benefit,” according to a federal website. The status allows a person to remain in the United States while “treated as an applicant for admission,” the site says. 据联邦政府网站称，美国政府会“出于紧急人道主义原因或重大公共利益”给予人们暂准居留身份。该网站说，这一身份允许一个人留在美国，同时“被视为入境申请人”。 Mr. Bolsonaro is expected to apply at some point for permanent resident status in the United States, known as a green card, a U.S. official said. That normally would happen after he is given an immigrant visa. Mr. Bolsonaro’s application for a green card would be processed quickly, similar to that of his younger brother before him, the official said. 一名美国官员说，博索纳罗预计将在适当时候申请美国永久居民身份，即绿卡。这通常要在他获得移民签证之后进行。该官员说，博索纳罗的绿卡申请将很快得到处理，类似他弟弟此前的情况。 The officials spoke on the condition of anonymity to discuss sensitive diplomatic matters. 这些官员要求匿名讨论敏感外交事务。 Mr. Bolsonaro’s younger brother, Eduardo Bolsonaro, lives in Texas and maintains close ties to the Trump administration, and was granted permanent resident status in July. The process takes years for most immigrants, but the younger Bolsonaro got expedited approval, a U.S. official said. 博索纳罗的弟弟爱德华多·博索纳罗住在得克萨斯州，与特朗普政府关系密切，并于7月获得永久居民身份。一名美国官员说，对大多数移民来说，这一过程需要数年，但爱德华多获得了加急批准。 Flávio Bolsonaro set off for the United States after Brazilian police asked him to turn over his passports on Monday because he is being investigated in relation to a money laundering scheme. 弗拉维奥·博索纳罗是在巴西警方周一要求他交出护照后前往美国的，因为他正因涉嫌参与洗钱计划接受调查。 While Mr. Bolsonaro, a right-wing senator who has held elected office for more than two decades, has not been formally charged with a crime, he will be stripped of his parliamentary immunity in early 2027 because he lost the presidential election on Sunday. He could then potentially face prosecution in relation to multiple criminal investigations. 博索纳罗是一名右翼参议员，担任民选公职超过20年。虽然他尚未被正式指控犯罪，但由于他在周日的总统大选中落败，其议会豁免权将于2027年初被剥夺。届时他可能因多项刑事调查面临起诉。 He flew late Tuesday from Argentina to Ecuador for refueling and finally to Miami, all on a private jet arranged by Jason Miller, a White House communications official, according to a person familiar with the logistics. Mr. Bolsonaro’s younger brother Eduardo has been in touch with Mr. Miller. The plan was put into motion on Monday, after Mr. Bolsonaro was told to turn in his passports, the person said. 据一名熟悉后勤安排的人士说，他周二深夜从阿根廷飞往厄瓜多尔加油，最终飞抵迈阿密，全程乘坐由白宫通讯官员贾森·米勒安排的私人飞机。博索纳罗的弟弟爱德华多一直与米勒保持联系。这名人士说，该计划是在周一博索纳罗被告知交出护照后启动的。 白宫通讯官员杰森·米勒去年在纽约。 On Sunday, Mr. Bolsonaro was decisively defeated in the election by the incumbent, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. 周日，博索纳罗在选举中被现任总统卢拉决定性地击败。 Mr. Miller, who is listed as a special U.S. government employee, declined to comment, and the White House referred only to public remarks by Mr. Trump, which did not address the private jet. The Wall Street Journal reported earlier on Mr. Miller’s involvement. He is an ally of the Bolsonaro family, and has said he was briefly detained on a visit to Brazil in 2021. 米勒被列为美国政府的特殊雇员，他拒绝置评，白宫仅提及特朗普的公开言论，而这些言论未涉及那架私人飞机。《华尔街日报》此前报道了米勒参与的情况。他是博索纳罗家族的盟友，并说自己曾在2021年访问巴西时被短暂拘留。 Mr. Bolsonaro, in a lengthy statement on social media on Wednesday afternoon, said he had left Brazil because he faced political persecution and thanked Mr. Trump and President Javier Milei of Argentina. After initially declaring himself the “legitimate president-elect” of Brazil, Mr. Bolsonaro deleted his statement and reposted it using the word “leader” instead. 博索纳罗周三下午在社交媒体上发表长篇声明，称他离开巴西是因为面临政治迫害，并感谢特朗普和阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱。他最初宣称自己是巴西“合法当选总统”，随后删除了声明，并重新发布，改用“领导人”一词。 “I address the Brazilian people and the international community as the leader of Brazil,” Mr. Bolsonaro said. Without offering credible evidence, he claimed the election that he lost was fraudulent and that he was the subject of a “witch hunt” by Brazil’s judiciary. “我作为巴西领导人向巴西人民和国际社会讲话，”博索纳罗说。在没有提供可信证据的情况下，他声称自己败选的选举存在舞弊，并称自己是巴西司法机构“政治迫害”的对象。 The White House’s assistance to Mr. Bolsonaro could escalate tensions between the Trump administration and Mr. Lula, who has accused Mr. Trump of interfering in Brazil’s internal affairs. 白宫对博索纳罗的援助可能加剧特朗普政府与卢拉之间的紧张关系。卢拉指责特朗普干涉巴西内政。 When asked about Mr. Bolsonaro on Wednesday, Mr. Trump said, “We gave him a pass to come into the country, so we’ll see. But I won’t get involved. It was a very strange election, that’s for sure.” 周三被问及博索纳罗时，特朗普说：“我们给了他入境我国的通行许可，所以看看会怎样吧。但我不会介入。那场选举非常奇怪，这是肯定的。” On Thursday, Mr. Trump declined to say who was the election’s legitimate winner. He said he had not taken sides in the vote because Mr. Lula had asked him to refrain from doing so. “I thought the election was a very great embarrassment to the people of Brazil,” he said. 周四，特朗普拒绝表态谁是选举的合法赢家。他说他没有在投票中选边站，因为卢拉曾要求他不要这样做。“我认为这次选举对巴西人民来说很难堪，”他说。 博索纳罗本月在里约热内卢参加竞选集会。 This year, the State Department under Secretary of State Marco Rubio took actions on Brazil after lobbying by the two Bolsonaro sons, The New York Times reported. 据《纽约时报》报道，今年，在博索纳罗兄弟的游说下，国务卿鲁比奥领导的国务院对巴西采取了行动。 The two are sons of a former right-wing president, Jair Bolsonaro, who is serving a lengthy sentence under house detention for attempting a coup. Flávio Bolsonaro conceded this week’s election, but seized on a change in the voting hours on Sunday to demand the outcome be annulled. 这两兄弟是前右翼总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗的儿子。雅伊尔·博索纳罗因试图发动政变正在接受长期居家监禁。弗拉维奥·博索纳罗承认了本周选举的结果，但利用周日投票时间的变化，要求宣布选举结果无效。 The change in hours, though, affected only 0.03 percent of the vote and Brazil’s electoral authorities said it did not make any difference to the result, given Mr. Lula’s winning margin of 4.4 million votes. International independent observers have certified the integrity of the election and dozens of countries have recognized the result. The United States and Argentina are not among them. 不过，投票时间变化仅影响0.03%的选票，巴西选举当局表示，鉴于卢拉以440万票的优势获胜，这对结果没有任何影响。国际独立观察员已认证选举的公正性，数十个国家已承认选举结果。美国和阿根廷不在其中。 Mr. Bolsonaro, in his statement on Wednesday, doubled down on his complaints. He also insisted that Mr. Lula had unfairly used government funds to win, citing the president’s move to raise a welfare stipend in the last stretch of the campaign. (Mr. Lula’s government has said the increase was an overdue inflation adjustment.) 博索纳罗在周三的声明中再次重申了他的指控。他还坚称卢拉不公平地利用政府资金赢得竞选，提到总统在竞选最后阶段提高福利补贴的举措。（卢拉政府表示，这一提高是迟来的通胀调整。） Mr. Bolsonaro crossed from Brazil to Argentina by land on Tuesday night with his wife and two daughters, Argentina’s National Directorate of Migration said Wednesday. It said that he then boarded a private fight to Guayaquil, Ecuador, and from there went on to the United States. 阿根廷国家移民局周三说，博索纳罗周二晚上与妻子和两个女儿从巴西陆路进入阿根廷。该局说，他随后登上一架飞往厄瓜多尔瓜亚基尔的私人飞机，并从那里前往美国。 On Monday, Brazilian authorities asked Mr. Bolsonaro to hand over his passports within 24 hours because of investigations into his links to a Brazilian lawyer accused of laundering more than $1 billion through a scheme involving online gambling. 周一，巴西当局要求博索纳罗在24小时内交出护照，因为正在调查他与一名巴西律师的关系。该律师被控通过涉及在线赌博的计划洗钱超过10亿美元。 Separately, Mr. Bolsonaro is the subject of a police inquiry over millions of dollars he raised to finance a biopic about his father from a disgraced banker at the center of a huge corruption scheme. 另外，博索纳罗还因从一名身处巨大腐败案中心的失势银行家那里筹集数以百万计的美元，用于拍摄关于其父亲的传记电影，因而受到警方调查。 When Mr. Bolsonaro did not turn in his passports by Tuesday morning, Brazilian authorities canceled the documents and issued an alert to immigration authorities barring Mr. Bolsonaro’s exit from the country. content: 黄安伟, ANA LONOVA, HAMED ALEAZIZ, TYLER PAGER 2026年10月30日 弗拉维奥·博索纳罗周三抵达迈阿密附近的奥帕洛卡机场。 Ricardo Arduengo/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images Flávio Bolsonaro, the Brazilian presidential candidate who faces multiple criminal investigations, is staying in Florida on a temporary status that was given following orders by President Trump, and will likely be granted permanent residency later, U.S. officials said. 美国官员表示，面临多项刑事调查的巴西总统候选人弗拉维奥·博索纳罗目前以特朗普总统下令授予的临时身份滞留佛罗里达州，并有望随后获得永久居留权。 Mr. Bolsonaro fled Brazil after losing an election this week . U.S. border agents allowed him and his family to enter the United States on what is called parole, usually given for humanitarian reasons, after they landed in Miami on a private jet on Wednesday morning, a U.S. official said that day. 博索纳罗 本周竞选失败 后逃离巴西。一名美国官员当天说，周三上午，博索纳罗及其家人乘坐私人飞机抵达迈阿密后，美国边境人员允许他们以所谓“暂准入境”身份入境，这种身份通常出于人道主义原因授予。 The jet had been arranged by a White House official. President Trump said later that afternoon that Mr. Bolsonaro had been given “a pass” to enter the country. 这架飞机由一名白宫官员安排。特朗普总统当天下午晚些时候说，博索纳罗获得了入境美国的“通行许可”。 The White House and the State Department referred questions about Mr. Bolsonaro’s parole status and Mr. Trump’s involvement to the Department of Homeland Security. That agency said Mr. Bolsonaro and his family “were met and inspected by U.S. Customs and Border Protection in accordance with applicable immigration laws and procedures. At the conclusion of the inspection, Mr. Bolsonaro and his accompanying family members were released.” 白宫和国务院将有关博索纳罗暂准入境身份及特朗普参与的问题转给国土安全部。国土安全部表示，博索纳罗及其家人“依照适用的移民法律和程序，接受了美国海关与边境保护局的接待和检查。检查结束后，博索纳罗及其随行家庭成员被放行”。 A public U.S. government record suggests that Mr. Bolsonaro presented a canceled Brazilian diplomatic passport on arrival, according to a review by The New York Times. The record lists a document with a number issued in Brazil that public disclosures show is linked to Mr. Bolsonaro’s diplomatic passport. 《纽约时报》查阅的一份美国政府公开记录显示，博索纳罗抵达时出示了一本已作废的巴西外交护照。该记录列出一个在巴西签发的证件编号，公开披露信息显示该号码与博索纳罗的外交护照有关。 The State Department said through an official on Tuesday that it planned to issue visas to Mr. Bolsonaro and his family allowing them to enter the country. title: thedotmack/claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More https://claude-mem.ai 🇨🇳 中文 • 🇹🇼 繁體中文 • 🇯🇵 日本語 • 🇵🇹 Português • 🇧🇷 Português • 🇰🇷 한국어 • 🇪🇸 Español • 🇩🇪 Deutsch • 🇫🇷 Français • 🇮🇱 עברית • 🇸🇦 العربية • 🇷🇺 Русский • 🇵🇱 Polski • 🇨🇿 Čeština • 🇳🇱 Nederlands • 🇹🇷 Türkçe • 🇺🇦 Українська • 🇻🇳 Tiếng Việt • 🇵🇭 Tagalog • 🇮🇩 Indonesia • 🇹🇭 ไทย • 🇮🇳 हिन्दी • 🇧🇩 বাংলা • 🇵🇰 اردو • 🇷🇴 Română • 🇸🇪 Svenska • 🇮🇹 Italiano • 🇬🇷 Ελληνικά • 🇭🇺 Magyar • 🇫🇮 Suomi • 🇩🇰 Dansk • 🇳🇴 Norsk Persistent memory compression system built for Claude Code. Quick Start • How It Works • Search Tools • Documentation • Configuration • Troubleshooting • License Claude-Mem seamlessly preserves context across sessions by automatically capturing tool usage observations, generating semantic summaries, and making them available to future sessions. This enables Claude to maintain continuity of knowledge about projects even after sessions end or reconnect. Quick Start Install claude-mem for Grok Bot: npx claude-mem install --ide grok-bot Grok Bot has no host hooks, so we watch the chat log files. Default is CMEM Pro, the hosted memory. Local observer is opt-in: --provider host. Installing this plugin does not install Cursor. Awareness push pilot (LFG + Orifice): needle observations (decision, bugfix, security_alert, sensitive) are appended as dated - YYYY-MM-DD [awareness] … lines into that bot's memory/log/YYYY-MM.md. Grok Bot already re-reads the log from disk. This does not write profile.md, user-memory, or project memory. Disable with CLAUDE_MEM_GROK_BOT_AWARENESS_ENABLED=false. Install with a single command: npx claude-mem install The installer sets everything up first, then asks you to sign in to claude-mem in your browser (email magic link — no card required). Signing in provisions a memory key for your account and unlocks the claude-mem observer with a 30 Day Free Trial: memory runs off-plan, so you get up to 100% more usage from your plan. When the free trial ends, memory automatically falls back to your Anthropic plan unless you subscribe. After sign-in you pick your memory provider — the claude-mem observer, your own OpenRouter or Gemini key, or your Anthropic plan. Prefer to skip the sign-in? Pass an explicit --provider flag, set CLAUDE_MEM_ONLINE_OPTIN=false, or run in CI/non-interactive shells — the installer completes without any account interaction. Or install for OpenCode: npx claude-mem install --ide opencode This works with OpenCode 1.3.4 or later, including OpenCode 2. Restart OpenCode after installing. Or install for T3 Code (Codex and Claude Code providers): npx claude-mem install --ide t3code The installer discovers T3 Code's enabled providers, registers native Claude-Mem plugins in their configured homes, and supports T3-managed Codex.
